title: Supreme Art — Pharmaceutical Packaging & Printing
description: Supreme Art manufactures pharmaceutical folding cartons, labels and leaflets in Pakistan, on Heidelberg, Bobst and hot-stamping machinery.

about.heading: Pharmaceutical packaging, made on advanced machinery.
about.text: Supreme Art makes printed cartons, labels and leaflets for pharmaceutical brands in Pakistan and abroad. What sets us apart is the equipment behind every job: Heidelberg Speedmaster presses that print five colours and a coating in a single pass, a high-precision hot-stamping machine for foils and security finishes, specialised coatings such as colour-shifting seals, and a new high-quality carton inspection machine now being installed.
points: Heidelberg Speedmaster CD 102 and SM 74: five colours plus coater
Hot stamping, colour-shifting seals and specialised coatings
A new high-quality carton inspection machine, being installed

media.alt: Heidelberg SM-74 press line at Supreme Art

pages.heading: Cartons for every kind of product.
pages.lead: From blister-pack tablets to syrups, supplements and spices, every carton is printed and finished under one roof in Pakistan.

items.title: Tablets & capsules
items.text: Cartons for blister and alu-alu strip packs, capsule and softgel packs, and tablet bottles, in straight-tuck, reverse-tuck and lock-bottom styles, from single strips to thirty-tablet packs.
items.alt: Tablet and capsule cartons: Bexus, Novex, Zolt, Duet, Carveda, Vazkor and Imo

items.title: Syrups & suspensions
items.text: Bottle cartons for syrups, dry-powder suspensions and drops, from 30 ml to 120 ml, with tuck-end or lock-bottom bases and room for the leaflet.
items.alt: Syrup cartons: Bronochol, Citolin, Fenbro 8, Fedralka, Pedrol and Novex Paracetamol

items.title: Nutraceuticals
items.text: Cartons for softgels, sachets, creams and tubes, ampoules and supplement jars, plus hanging packs with a euro slot for the pharmacy shelf.
items.alt: Nutraceutical cartons: Vosun-D, Herbion Seaweed cream, Quench, Algae-Vit, Nova-Plast and Calciferol

items.title: Food
items.text: Spice, masala and dessert-mix cartons in tuck-end and four- and six-corner styles, finished with food-grade water-base coatings.
items.alt: SwaaD food cartons: Chapli Kabab, Kali Mirch, Shahi Kheer and Bombay Biryani

items.title: Labels & stickers
items.text: Wrap-around bottle labels, front-and-back labels and stickers for syrups, drops and suspensions, printed to match their cartons.
items.alt: Labelled syrup bottles: Bronochol, Omevex, Pedrol, Citolin, Imo IV and Feromalt

finishes.heading: Finishes that protect and stand out.
finishes.lead: Security features, special coatings and foils, applied in-house after printing.

process.heading: From artwork to flat-packed carton.
process.lead: Three chapters under one roof in Pakistan — this is how a carton is made at Supreme Art.

quality.heading: Built for pharma standards.
quality.text: Medicine packaging doesn’t get second chances. We run documented quality assurance across every stage: incoming board, Pantone-matched colour verified with a spectrophotometer on press, coating checks, hand inspection of every unit carton by our QC team, and a digital job card that follows each order from board to delivery.

clients.heading: Our clients.
clients.lead: Pharmaceutical and consumer brands that rely on Supreme Art for their packaging.

posts.title: Expanding our production floor
posts.text: More space and more capacity on the factory floor, so large pharmaceutical orders move through faster.

posts.title: A new high-quality inspection machine
posts.text: A new carton inspection machine is being installed to check every unit carton for colour, print and text.

posts.title: A new hot-stamping machine
posts.text: Sharper foils and security finishes, applied in-house with greater speed and precision.

cta.text: Send us your artwork or dieline — we'll come back with a quote and a timeline.
